select 'exp' k, e.key a, e.state b, (select count(*) from experiment_versions v join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id and d.ended_at is null where v.experiment_id=e.id and (ep.ended_at is null or d.id is not null))::text c from experiments e where e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size','mmsell-win-set','mmsell-win-set-2')
union all
select 'ie', i.kind, coalesce(d.deployment_key,'-'), i.detected_at::text from experiment_integrity_events i left join experiment_deployments d on d.id=i.deployment_id where i.detected_at > '2026-11-01 22:15'
union all
select 'dead', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where (created_at > '2026-11-01 23:02:10' and strategy in ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Fmmsell10','Jmmsell10','Kmmsell10','Nmmsell10','Vmmsell10','Pmmsell10','Qmmsell10')) or (created_at > '2026-11-02 14:50' and strategy in ('mmsell9','mmsell10')) group by strategy
union all
select 'pt24', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and strategy in ('Xmmsell10','Ymmsell10','Smmsell10','Zmmsell10') group by strategy
union all
select 'lo24', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from live_orders where created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' group by strategy
